Column theorem and original step 1.1: vertical d0=0 leaves four k on E1; h11=1 kills (1,1) and (0,1) on E2, leaving k at (0,0),(1,0). Remaining d1 is zero, and bidegree (−r,r−1) for r≥2 cannot join the surviving positions. Left panel shows precisely these four values.

Both page panels use p rightward and q upward, explicitly stated in their caption.

Original steps 1.3 and 2.1 give H1=k represented by C10 modulo boundaries C01. def-row-and-column-filtrations-of-a-first-quadrant-double-complex uses original vertical cutoff for row and horizontal cutoff for column. C10 enters row cutoff 0 and column cutoff 1, while the sole degree-one term in column cutoff 0 is boundary C01. Thus Frow_−1=0,Frow_0=H1,Fcol_0=0,Fcol_1=H1, exactly as captioned.
